notes.title: Patch v1.6.2
notes.content:
Hello new DCOs. Thank you all for your continued support and your bug reporting.



 Here's what's new in v1.6.2

Fixing an uncommon softlock bug that could occur if you rapidly opened and closed the Pause menu repeatedly, that would prevent you from being able to interact with anything until Saving & Loading your game. 👉🔨

notes.title: Patch v1.6.1
notes.content:
Hello. Anyone still here? Just a real quick patch to fix one major issue a hero reported.

Here's what's new in v1.6.1


 Fixing a rare game breaking bug that could occur if you had the worst luck in the world, and you happened to enable the "Disable Cursive" option in the Accessibility settings while in the middle of a typing session
 Removing a lot of weird and confusing abbreviations specifically for North Charleston. (NO CHAS)

notes.title: Patch v1.6
notes.content:
Thank you Data Conversion Operators for your valuable bug reports, feedback, and reviews.

Here's what's new in v1.6:


 Fixing a bug where if you Saved and Quit with a very specific timing (right after starting your workday at the computer), if you then- from the Titlescreen- immediately loaded the Save it would put the game into such a w e i r d and cursed state that it even freaked ME out with how suddenly foreign and unreliable certain things now became... somehow while still kinda 'functioning'? As fun as this was though, it could easily soft lock the game (and possibly kill your playthrough)
 Patched a bug where you could possibly phase through the locked fence in the stairwell, and your reward was prematurely being locked away forever in a dark descending abyss
 Fixing an annoying bug where if you exited the Pause screen while standing in front of something interactable, it would be interacted with
 Fixed some unintended lighting oddities that could occur in the apartment
 Fixed an edge case bug where key in the Key Rebinding screen in Settings could eventually forget its default bindings if you reset it with the Backspace key several times, whoops
Fixed misc UI timing bugs 
 Key Rebinding screen will now alert you if you've bound the same key to multiple actions

notes.title: Patch v1.5.1
notes.content:
Fixing an issue where if you saw the  W▀░▒░▐,░N ending a 2nd time, a portion of it would be super dark
 Fixing some typos. "It's" is a villain.
 Fixing an issue that would prevent ░▐  ░▒░▐ from appearing
 Fixing insanely rare but technically achievable collision issue in the final section
 Fixed bug with the content warning not showing correctly for first time launch
 Some optimizations and memory reduction improvements

notes.title: The BLOODY KEYS Bundle
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520437/200563c5b1f4bb42ccc0aa15ae4a630b8b924143.png

DEAD LETTER DEPT. + BLOOD TYPERS TEAM UP TO CREATE THE 'BLOODY KEYS' BUNDLE
 
Belief Engine & Outer Brain Studios have teamed up to create the 'Bloody Keys' Steam bundle, where you can nab both DEAD LETTER DEPT. + Blood Typers, both iconic new horror typing games, for a discount.

The game Organ Quarter, also by Outer Brain Studios, is one of my personal favorite VR horror games ever. So it's a big honor to be able to make this bundle with them on their brand new release Blood Typers.

What is Blood Typers?
TYPE TO KILL in this survival horror adventure, played entirely with your keyboard. Blast zombies, manage your inventory, and work together to survive and escape. Choose from a roster of characters then plan your escape from this bloody homage to old school horror. But remember... death is just a typo away.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520437/6621874ba7e7d9a8b29f09d4f41190de9911e143.png

In singleplayer or 1-4 player co-op, you find yourself trapped in a procedurally generated movie campus as it warps into a nightmare. Manage its limited resources right or you might not make it through the night…

Check out the 'Bloody Keys' Bundle here:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50718/Bloody_Keys/

notes.title: Patch v1.5 [Linux Users Please Read]
notes.content:
Hot fixing a critical issue preventing native Linux build from launching correctly if you have updated glibc to v2.41 (which apparently broke a lot of backwards compatibility, and fun fact was released the same day as DEAD LETTER DEPT.) Steam Forum thread about it here.
 Cloud syncing on Linux should now fully function correctly
 Fixing a rare edgecase issue where entering a Vertical Tab (somehow) in a very very specific circumstance could somehow cause the save data to get corrupted and ultimately reset itself. Also, I learned that Vertical Tabs are apparently a thing, but how you enter one in 2025 is a complete mystery to me (chime in if you're familiar with using these in the modern age).
 Adding an error screen on launch to notify you if the Save Data is corrupted/not loadable, which will give you some options to consider. Mainly added this to catch any other weird circumstances after encountering the crazy Vertical Tab thing. If I'm very lucky nobody will ever see it.
 Fixing the Recommended Controller layout for SteamDeck not showing up correctly
 Fixing minor bug where the Display Resolution setting would get confused and show the wrong entry
 Several other minor polish & fixes

notes.title: Patch v1.4
notes.content:

 Entire UI has been all adjusted to now properly layout for all horizontal based aspect ratios instead of clipping off the screen for edge cases like 3:2. Even in the weirdest of ratios it will still try its best.


Thank you very much for your reviews and your bug reports.

notes.title: DEAD LETTER DEPT. is NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Taking a temp job while you get situated in a new city, you are tasked with data-entry-like work of typing up the words and addresses on mail & letters that were not deliverable- due to bad handwriting or other odd reasons. As the days pass, strange stories begin to emerge from the mail, you can't ever shake this feeling you're being watched.

[previewyoutube=uCByepaHNyg;full][/previewyoutube]

Working in a dingy warehouse, isolated from anyone and everyone, your only connection to the outside world are glimpses of letters that couldn't reach their destination. As time goes on, working conditions become questionable and dreamlike. Oddities and cracks begin to appear. Making money for rent is important, but at what cost.


USE YOUR COMPUTER KEYBOARD to type in various prompts, and attempt to decipher damaged images
MULTIPLE ENDINGS & buried secrets to uncover
NO TWO PLAYTHROUGHS are exactly the same
A MASSIVE AMOUNT OF MAIL to voyeur through, and catch glimpses into other lives
ATMOSPHERIC HORROR MOOD with rich sound designed to crawl under your skin


A technological & voyeuristic ghost story. Type your way to freedom or into oblivion.

The sun is setting, it's time to go to work.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627350/Dead_Letter_Dept/


If you encounter any issues in your journeys, please don't hesitate to reach out or create a thread in the Steam forums. You can also find Feedback/Bug links in the Pause menu.
